Rule 1 says the strings `http://` and `https://` must not appear ANYWHERE in dist/index.html.
Rule 2 says the tag `<script src="https://cdn.acme-widgets.test/aw.js"></script>` must be present exactly once, byte for byte.

The mandated tag literally contains the 8-byte sequence `https://` at bytes 14–21 of the tag. If the tag is present "byte for byte", then `https://` appears in the file, which violates rule 1's "anywhere". No file can contain the exact byte sequence of the tag without also containing `https://`, so both rules cannot hold simultaneously.

- Original tag (`https://cdn...`): rule2 = 1 pass, rule1 = 1 fail (the tag itself is the offender).
- Charref trick (`https://`): rule1 = 0 pass, rule2 = 0 fail - the required literal tag is no longer present.
